title: OpenAlex Upstream API Outage
summary: OpenAlex search queries returned 502/503 errors due to upstream provider outage. Fallback cache handled cached user requests successfully. SRE applied kill switch after 18-minute cascade window.
corrective_actions: CA-001: Implement circuit breaker on OpenAlex httpx client
CA-002: Add OpenAlexApiHighErrorRate Prometheus alert rule
CA-003: Add OpenAlex failure runbook section to incident.md
CA-004: Track OpenAlex API per-status-code metrics
root_cause: No circuit breaker on OpenAlex API client — upstream outage cascaded to HTTP 502 errors for 18 minutes before manual kill switch was applied.

title: LLM Service Rate Limits Exhaustion
summary: Groq API daily token quota exhausted by concurrent background enrichment jobs and user-facing agent chat. Traffic failed over to OpenRouter models after a 15-minute error window.
corrective_actions: CA-002: Add LlmApiQuotaApproaching early-warning Prometheus alert
CA-003: Rate-limit background enrichment jobs to 30% of daily Groq quota
CA-004: Separate Groq API keys for background vs live traffic
CA-005: Add LLM rate limit runbook section to incident.md
root_cause: Background profile enrichment jobs and live user-facing agent chat shared the same Groq API key with no token quota coordination, causing daily quota exhaustion.
